findings.description: File discovery invokes git ls-files with repository configuration enabled. In a repository configured with an executable core.fsmonitor hook, inventory can execute that hook during status or refresh. Adding --no-filters to hash-object prevents clean-filter execution but leaves this separate execution path open, violating retained FR-374. The adapter mirrors contain the same behavior.
findings.evidence: Static inspection identified the reachable Git calls. Retained tests cover clean filters but provide no fsmonitor regression evidence. All 82 context-lock file hashes matched. No files were modified, tests run, or exploit reproduction executed during this review.
findings.recommendation: Disable core.fsmonitor explicitly for inventory commands in both Git wrappers and add coverage asserting that a configured executable hook never runs.
